verdict.rationale: Maritime's docs say each agent runs in its own micro-VM: the Claude Code page cites 'its own always-on micro-VM', and the configuration docs say secrets are 'injected only into that agent's VM'. Per-agent VM isolation is therefore implied. However, these are passing mentions, not a documented security or isolation boundary. missing for 10: dedicated isolation/security architecture docs (hypervisor/microVM technology, tenant separation guarantees, network isolation from customer systems), confirmation that the microVM applies to all agent types beyond the Claude Code page, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems

citations.quote: its own always-on micro-VM in the cloud
injected only into that agent's VM
